instruction: Update the folder name from "notes_draft" to "notes_final".

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires renaming folder 'notes_draft' to 'notes_final'. Evaluator checks if the renamed folder exists using command-line check with exact_match metric.

llm_judge_reasons: Complete verification: The evaluator correctly checks BOTH required conditions for a rename operation
Command verifies (1) target directory '~/Desktop/notes_final' exists AND (2) source directory '~/Desktop/notes_draft' does NOT exist
The && operator ensures both conditions must be true, preventing false positives from copy or create operations
Metric 'exact_match' is appropriate for verifying the command output
Expected value 'Renamed successfully.\n' correctly matches the command output when both conditions are met
The evaluator can correctly distinguish rename from copy (which would leave source intact) or create (which wouldn't remove source)
